narr: Showers and thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to Berks County during the late afternoon and early evening of July 24. Rainfall totals were as high as 1 to 2 inches.
ev: Several vehicles were stranded in flood waters on East Lancaster Avenue along the border between Shillington and Cumru Township.
